goal: Prove that the five real PMCR-O plugins (orchestrator, planner, maker, checker, reflector) compose end-to-end -- not just validate in isolation -- by hand-running one full governed cycle on this trivial, real task and recording the result as trail evidence.

steps.action: Execute this cycle's remaining phases via each plugin's real command (orchestrate and plan are already done as part of reaching this step); append one MakeStep to make.jsonl recording that the orchestrate->plan handoff produced a correctly schema-shaped PlanFrame, and note any friction or gap observed while doing so.

Independently verify, against this PlanFrame's success_criteria, that orchestrate.jsonl/plan.jsonl/make.jsonl each contain exactly one correctly schema-shaped frame produced by their respective real plugin command, and that no command in this cycle returned a reject_code; append one CheckFrame with a PASS/FAIL verdict per criterion and overall.

Close the cycle: record a Reflection with a disposition reflecting whether the five-plugin orchestrate->plan->make->check->reflect-and-seed contract composed cleanly end-to-end, optionally propose and enqueue a next seed if any friction or gap was found, then seal the trail.

success_criteria: orchestrate.jsonl, plan.jsonl, make.jsonl, and check.jsonl each contain exactly one correctly schema-shaped frame, each produced by invoking that phase's real plugin command (not hand-written JSON).
No command invoked during this cycle (orchestrate run, plan run, make run, check run) returned a reject_code.
The CheckFrame's overall verdict is PASS.
reflect.jsonl contains one Reflection and the trail is sealed.
out_of_scope: Modifying any of the five plugins' own scripts, assets, or schemas.
Any application/product code changes -- the 'real task' this cycle proves composition against is the cycle itself.
